description_en: Retrieves a list of user-uploaded tables from the data center, for file types only
description_zh: 获取数据中心用户上传的表列表，仅支持文件类型，不支持数据库类型
kebab_example: aliyun dms list-data-center-table --dms-unit cn-hangzhou --instance-name f-ean8u5881qk4000000000xh5y --database-name diamonds.csv --table-name diamonds --search-key testdb --import-type FILE --page-number 1 --page-size 20 --call-from '仅前端使用' --region cn-hangzhou
